text_en: Now the Spirit expressly says that in later times some will renounce the faith by paying attention to deceitful spirits and teachings of demons,
text_cn: 圣神明明地说：在最后的时期，有些人要背弃信德，听信欺诈的神和魔鬼的训言，

text_en: through the hypocrisy of liars whose consciences are seared with a hot iron.
text_cn: 这训言是出于那些伪善的说谎者，他们的良心已烙上了火印。

text_en: They forbid marriage and demand abstinence from foods, which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
text_cn: 他们禁止嫁娶，戒绝一些食物；这些食物本是天主所造，叫那信仰而认识真理的人，以感恩的心所享用的；

text_en: For everything created by God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, provided it is received with thanksgiving;
text_cn: 因为天主所造的样样都好，如以感恩的心领受，没有一样是可摈弃的；

text_en: for it is sanctified by God’s word and by prayer.
text_cn: 因为样样都是藉天主的话和祈祷祝圣了的。

text_en: If you put these instructions before the brothers and sisters, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished on the words of the faith and of the sound teaching that you have followed.
text_cn: 你若拿这些话提醒弟兄们，就是基督耶稣的好仆役，并显出你在信德和你一向所追随的好教训上得到好的教育。

text_en: Have nothing to do with profane myths and old wives’ tales. Train yourself in godliness,
text_cn: 至于凡俗和老妇的无稽传说，务要躲避！但要在虔敬上操练自己，

text_en: for, while physical training is of some value, godliness is valuable in every way, holding promise for both the present life and the life to come.
text_cn: 因为身体的操练益处不多，惟独虔敬在各方面都有益处，因为有今生与来生的应许。

text_en: The saying is sure and worthy of full acceptance.
text_cn: 这话是确实的，值得完全接纳。

text_en: For to this end we toil and struggle, because we have our hope set on the living God, who is the Savior of all people, especially of those who believe.
text_cn: 我们劳苦奋斗，正是如此，因为我们已寄望于永生的天主，他是全人类，尤其是信徒们的救主。

text_en: These are the things you must insist on and teach.
text_cn: 你要拿这些事去指导和教训人，

text_en: Let no one despise your youth, but set the believers an example in speech and conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
text_cn: 不要让人小看你年轻；但要在言语行为上，在爱德、信德和洁德上，做信徒的模范。

text_en: Until I arrive, give attention to the public reading of scripture, to exhorting, to teaching.
text_cn: 直到我来时，你要专务宣读、劝勉和教导。

text_en: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you through prophecy with the laying on of hands by the council of elders.
text_cn: 不要疏忽你心内的神恩，即从前因预言，藉长老团的覆手赐予你的神恩。

text_en: Put these things into practice, devote yourself to them, so that all may see your progress.
text_cn: 你要专心做这些事，全神贯注在这些事上，为使众人看出你的进步。

text_en: Pay close attention to yourself and to your teaching; continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and your hearers.
text_cn: 应注意你自己和你的训言，在这些事上要坚持不变，因为你这样做，才能救你自己，又能救你的听众。
